metric_en: Maximum relative gm error on 78 retained transfer-grid probes

metric_en: Maximum relative charge error in a near-zero numerical stress test
metric_zh: 近零电压数值压力测试的最大电荷相对误差

reference_zh: 原电荷方程的70位Decimal参考；294个探针点，|Vj|=1e-18至1e-6V，正负两种极性及三个温度。
limits_en: Stress-test range is explicitly separate from the original plotted CV sweep; eliminates cancellation, not an across-the-board measured capacitance improvement.
limits_zh: 压力测试电压范围与原绘制的CV扫描明确分开；消除数值相消，不表示全部实测电容精度提高。

metric_zh: 最大归一化端口KCL残差

reference_zh: Ebers-Moll三端电流守恒精确关系：Ic+Ib+Ie=0。

limits_zh: 保留既有expm1解析计算；残差已在浮点精度量级，不赋予数值提升百分比。

metric_en: Asymptotic relative sampling SE of estimated Gaussian pair sigma
metric_zh: 高斯配对标准差估计的渐近相对抽样标准误
reference_en: Delta-method approximation SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1)); fourfold samples. This is a sampling-uncertainty estimate, not a deterministic error.
reference_zh: Delta方法近似SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1))；样本量增至四倍。此为抽样不确定度估计，不是确定性误差。
limits_en: Reported separately from numerical accuracy. A single realized sigma estimate may move either direction; no foundry statistics or yield improvement.
limits_zh: 与数值准确度分开报告；单次标准差估计可能向任一方向变化，不代表工艺统计或良率改善。

metric_zh: 理想尾电流最大相对残差

limits_en: 80 bisection steps already reach double-precision resolution; retained unchanged, no fabricated 10% gain.

metric_en: Maximum RMS noise integration error across six band integrals
metric_zh: 六个带内积分的最大噪声均方根误差

metric_zh: 输出电压轨迹最大误差
reference_en: Independent adaptive Dormand-Prince 5(4), tighter run rtol=1e-11/atol=1e-13, continuous ramp and aligned load event; common 10us times, all 18 cases.
